sentences.text: Who left all this clutter on the floor?

sentences.text: His smile reassured me everything would be alright.

sentences.text: It was the result of years of sacrifices.

sentences.text: The government is trying to find a solution.

sentences.text: He worked as an apprentice for three years.
sentences.meaning: Anh ấy đã làm học việc được ba năm rồi.

sentences.text: I don't understand what she's trying to say.
sentences.meaning: Tôi không hiểu cô ấy đang định nói gì.

sentences.text: I often use SSH to access my computers remotely.

sentences.text: Health and intellect are the two blessings of life.

sentences.text: They aren't as naive as they used to be.
